  ROUND(AVG(m.profit), 2) AS avg_monthly,

  ROUND(MIN(m.profit),2) AS min_month,
  ROUND(MAX(m.profit),2) AS max_month,
  COUNT(*) AS n_orders

      FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%' GROUP BY month, prov2) m
  ON m.prov2 = substr(Destination, 1, instr(substr(Destination, instr(Destination,'-')+1), '-') + instr(Destination,'-'))
WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%'
GROUP BY province
ORDER BY year_profit DESC
